jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer | $80/hr | Remote
jobs.description:
Full-Stack Software Engineers, Backend & Frontend Developers. Remote AI Project

We are seeking experienced Full-Stack Software Engineers, Backend Engineers, Frontend Engineers, Application Developers, and Software Engineers to contribute to advanced AI training through realistic software development, debugging, architecture, and code-evaluation tasks.

You will work across complete application stacks, including browser applications, APIs, backend services, databases, authentication, integrations, infrastructure, and deployment, while reviewing and improving complex software solutions across multiple programming languages.

What You’ll Do

Develop and modify frontend and backend application components
Build user-facing features and the APIs, services, and data models that support them
Debug issues across browsers, frontend applications, backend services, databases, and external integrations
Trace requests and data through complete application workflows
Work inside unfamiliar repositories and quickly understand existing architecture
Diagnose authentication, authorization, persistence, networking, state-management, and deployment issues
Review and improve software written in multiple programming languages
Translate full software implementations from one programming language or technology stack into another
Preserve functionality, behavior, architecture, and edge-case handling during code translation
Review AI-generated code for correctness, completeness, performance, security, and maintainability
Identify bugs, missing functionality, architectural weaknesses, and implementation shortcuts
Refactor existing code while maintaining expected application behavior
Create technically rigorous reference solutions and validation criteria
Document technical decisions, assumptions, tradeoffs, and implementation details

Who Can Apply

Relevant backgrounds include:

Full-Stack Software Engineers, Senior Full-Stack Engineers, Staff Full-Stack Engineers, Principal Full-Stack Engineers, Full-Stack Developers, Senior Software Engineers, Software Developers, Application Engineers, Application Developers, Product Engineers, and Web Application Engineers.

Frontend backgrounds may include:

Frontend Engineers, Senior Frontend Engineers, React Engineers, React Developers, JavaScript Engineers, TypeScript Engineers, UI Engineers, Web Engineers, Angular Developers, Vue Developers, Next.js Developers, and Client-Side Application Engineers with meaningful backend experience.

Backend backgrounds may include:

Backend Engineers, Senior Backend Engineers, API Engineers, Server-Side Engineers, Node.js Engineers, Python Backend Engineers, Java Backend Engineers, .NET Engineers, Go Engineers, Rust Engineers, and Backend Application Developers with meaningful frontend experience.

Additional relevant backgrounds include:

Platform Engineers, Systems Engineers, Cloud Engineers, Distributed Systems Engineers, Software Architects, Technical Leads, Developer Tools Engineers, Integration Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Site Reliability Engineers, SREs, and Infrastructure Engineers who regularly work across application layers.

Language-focused candidates may include:

Python Engineers, Java Engineers, C# Developers, .NET Developers, C++ Engineers, Golang Engineers, Go Developers, Rust Engineers, TypeScript Developers, JavaScript Developers, Kotlin Engineers, PHP Developers, Ruby Developers, Scala Engineers, and Polyglot Software Engineers.

Relevant Full-Stack Experience

Strong candidates may have experience with:

Frontend application development
Backend service development
REST APIs
GraphQL APIs
RPC and gRPC services
Browser applications
Server-side applications
Authentication and authorization
Session management
Application state
Database design
ORM and query layers
Caching
File storage
Background jobs
Message queues
Event-driven systems
Third-party integrations
Webhooks
Cloud deployment
Containerized applications
Observability
Logging
Monitoring
CI/CD
Production debugging

Requirements

Strong professional experience building and shipping production full-stack applications
Meaningful hands-on experience with both frontend and backend engineering
Production experience with multiple programming languages
Strong understanding of browser applications, APIs, application state, databases, and service integrations
Experience understanding and contributing to complete software architectures
Ability to work effectively inside unfamiliar repositories
Strong debugging and technical problem-solving skills
Ability to trace failures across multiple application layers
Experience reading and evaluating code written by other engineers
Ability to reason about correctness, performance, security, and maintainability
Strong written communication and technical documentation skills
Ability to work independently on technically complex tasks

Preferred Background

Senior-level full-stack engineering experience
Experience owning complete features from UI through database
Experience working across multiple programming languages
Experience translating or migrating software between languages or frameworks
Experience modernizing legacy applications
Experience working with large or mature production codebases
Experience with distributed systems and cloud infrastructure
Experience conducting rigorous code reviews
Experience debugging production incidents
Experience designing APIs and database schemas
Experience building secure authentication and authorization systems
Experience mentoring software engineers
Experience writing technical design documents

jobs.description:
Enterprise IT-Spezialist mit agilem Mindset und Hands-On Mentalität und Teil der SYZYGY Group.
Mit mehr als 100 Spezialist:innen entwickeln und betreiben wir maßgeschneiderte Softwarelösungen für große Unternehmen wie Continental, Deutsche Bahn, Porsche, Samsung oder Telefonica (o2).
Wir erstellen individuelle Lösungen, die mitdenken. Dabei sind wir hands-on, tech-hungrig, ein wenig nerdy, kommunikativ und echte Teamplayer.
Aktuell suchen wir (vor Ort in Bad Homburg, remote oder teil remote):
Senior .NET Developer (w/m/d)

Du arbeitest gern dort, wo fachliche Anforderungen und technische Komplexität zusammenkommen? Als Senior .NET Developer übersetzt Du beides in belastbare Lösungen für große Enterprise-Projekte.
Dann bist Du bei uns goldrichtig! Wir, SYZYGY Techsolutions – und in Zukunft hoffentlich Du – sind ein in jeder Hinsicht bunter Haufen Nerds.

Aufgaben

Enterprise Webentwicklung

Als Teil eines cross-funktionalen Teams entwickelst Du in großen IT-Projekten moderne Enterprise-Webanwendungen mit .NET (C#). Aktuell arbeiten wir unter anderem mit .NET 10, ASP.NET Core Web API, GraphQL, CI/CD und modernen Cloud-Lösungen.
Architektur und Entwicklungsmethoden

Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team arbeitet Ihr mit modernen Konzepten und Methoden wie SOA, serverless, DDD, TDD und Continuous Delivery.
Agile Zusammenarbeit

Agilität schreiben wir und Du groß. Ihr arbeitet mit agilen Methoden wie beispielsweise Scrum.
Technische Verantwortung

Du bist technische:r Ansprechpartner:in für Dein Team sowie für interne und externe Schnittstellen.
Kundenorientierte Lösungen

Du analysierst Anforderungen, entwickelst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team passgenaue Lösungen und setzt sie im Dialog mit der Kundenseite um.

Profil

In der Webentwicklung mit .NET und .NET Core bringst Du mehrjährige Erfahrung mit.
Backend-Services mit REST oder GraphQL hast Du bereits entwickelt und bereitgestellt.
Mit gängigen Datenbanksystemen wie MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle oder MongoDB kennst Du Dich sehr gut aus.
Erfahrung mit AWS oder Azure ist ein Plus.
Als echter Teamplayer stehst Du Deinem Team jederzeit gerne mit Rat und Tat zur Seite.
Ein offener und klarer Kommunikationsstil sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

Wir bieten

Full remote, Office oder hybrid

Du arbeitest am liebsten im Homeoffice? Du kommst gerne jeden Tag ins Büro? Oder bevorzugst Du die Mischung? Bei uns ist alles möglich. Mit unserer State-of-the-Art Hardware hast Du volle Flexibilität.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten & voller Überstundenausgleich

Morgens mal später anfangen. Oder mal früher in den Feierabend. Kein Problem. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitszeiten machen es möglich. Und sollten doch mal Überstunden anfallen, bekommst Du hierfür den vollen Freizeitausgleich. 

Gehaltspaket

Zusätzlich zum Gehalt bekommst Du optional Zuschüsse zu vermögenswirksamen Leistungen und zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge. Außerdem honorieren wir langjährige, engagierte Mitarbeit in Form einer Sonderzahlung. Und Du profitierst von attraktiven Rabattprogrammen.

Weiterbildung & Trainings

Nutze Dein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget, um an Trainings oder Konferenzen teilzunehmen. Gestalte aktiv Deine Entwicklung, wir unterstützen Dich dabei!

Urlaub & Workation

Bei uns gibt es bei Vollzeit 32 freie Tage im Jahr: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub und Heiligabend sowie Silvester sind arbeitsfrei. Zusätzlich gibt es für besondere Anlässe Sonderurlaubstage. Außerdem ist temporäres Arbeiten im Ausland möglich.

Mentale & physische Gesundheit

Du erhältst professionelles Mental Health Coaching sowie über unseren Wellpass-Benefit flexiblen Zugang zu einem großen Netzwerk aus Sport- und Wellnessangeboten – vor Ort und online.

Important note

Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered.

jobs.title: Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d) – Cloud & Microservices / C# / .NET
jobs.description:
Tiere. Technologie. Zukunft

Sano steht für nachhaltige Tierernährung – von Mineralfutter und Kälbermilch bis zu Spezialprodukten für Rinder und Schweine. Unser Produktportfolio ist so vielfältig wie die Landwirtschaft selbst. Als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines Familienunternehmens mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit. Ein Unternehmen, das seit Jahrzehnten weiß, worauf es ankommt: gesunde Tiere, nachhaltige Prozesse – und IT, die das möglich macht.

Was dich erwartet? Kurze Entscheidungswege, ein Team mit echtem Antrieb und eine Branche, die Nachhaltigkeit nicht nur predigt, sondern lebt.

Hier bist du gefragt - deine Aufgaben

Als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d) technische Verantwortung für unsere Plattform übernehmen und aktiv mitgestalten, wie unsere Software in Zukunft aufgebaut ist.
Sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team spannende Lösungen erarbeiten, die bereits heute in der Landwirtschaft eingesetzt und von dir kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.
Mit deinem Gespür für den richtigen Code Struktur in komplexe Systeme bringen, unsere Cloud-Plattform gestalten und dabei die langfristige Tragfähigkeit unserer Lösungen im Blick behalten.
Standards, Schnittstellen und technische Leitplanken definieren, neue Technologien bewerten und fundierte Architekturentscheidungen treffen.
Mit deinem Blick für das Wesentliche moderne Architekturansätze wie Microservices oder API-basierte Systeme sinnvoll einbringen.
Last, but not least beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer DevOps- und CI/CD-Strukturen supporten.

Das bringst du mit – dein Profil

Idealerweise eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit IT-Bezug – was zählt: Du brennst für IT und Softwarearchitektur
Ein Muss: Berufspraxis als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d), Solution Architect (m/w/d) oder Lead Developer (m/w/d)
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in C# und .NET (Core/6/7/8)
Sehr gutes Verständnis moderner Softwarearchitekturen (Microservices, Event-Driven, API-Design, Messaging) sowie fundiertes Know-how in Security-Konzepten
Erfahrung in Cloud-Plattformen (AWS, Azure oder Google Cloud), in Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und in Datenplattformen, Datenbanken sowie IoT-Architekturen
Kenntnisse in DevOps, CI/CD und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform, Bicep, GitOps) sowie Expertise im Monitoring, Logging und Tracing Spaß daran, technische Themen verständlich zu vermitteln und in (komplexen) Architekturen zu denken

Deine Vorteile bei Sano

Gute Arbeit, guter Verdienst: attraktives Gehaltspaket
Werkzeug, das begeistert: moderne Ausstattung für deinen Arbeitsalltag
Zeit für dich: 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr
Beruf trifft Leben: Flexible Modelle zur Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf – damit wir dich in jeder Lebensphase begleiten
Hier bist du richtig: ein zukunftssicheres Umfeld, das auf dich wartet
Rundum gut versorgt: arbeitgeberfinanzierte Krankenzusatzversicherung & betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Sattel auf, Zukunft an: Business Bike
Gemeinsam mehr erleben: besondere Teamevents, die verbinden
Kleine Aufmerksamkeiten, große Wirkung: spannende Mitarbeitergeschenke
Wissen, das wächst: die Sano Akademie – dein Ort für Entwicklung und Weiterbildung

jobs.title: Software Solutions Project Manager (BF3544B)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with an established UK software and services business that provides cloud-based infrastructure-management systems to local authorities and utility-sector organisations. Its project team delivers implementations, development work and change programmes that connect customer requirements with product, consultancy and technical delivery.

This role takes responsibility for software projects across the full lifecycle, from scope and planning through governance, delivery and closure. You will be the main customer contact, coordinating colleagues and third parties who may not report directly to you, while keeping scope, quality, budget and timescales under control. The opportunity is available on either a permanent basis or as a 12-month fixed-term appointment.

The Role

Manage the end-to-end delivery of software implementations, development, consultancy and change projects.
Define scope, objectives, deliverables and acceptance criteria, then maintain project plans, schedules, budgets and resource forecasts.
Track progress and manage risks, issues, dependencies and change requests, escalating clearly when delivery is at risk.
Act as the primary customer contact, chairing project meetings, workshops, reviews and steering groups.
Coordinate resources across professional services, product, support, development and account management, building accountability through influence rather than line authority.
Monitor project commercials, including budgets, profitability and utilisation, while maintaining contractual and governance standards.
Keep status reports, RAID logs and other project records accurate, and use lessons learned to improve future delivery.

What We're Looking For

Proven experience delivering software development, implementation or digital-transformation projects.
The ability to run several projects and competing priorities without losing control of detail, outcomes or stakeholder communication.
Strong customer and stakeholder management skills, including the credibility to lead cross-functional groups and handle difficult conversations calmly.
Commercial awareness and practical experience managing budgets, resources, risks and governance documentation.
Clear written and verbal communication, with an ability to translate technical subjects into business-focused decisions.
A collaborative, resilient approach and the judgement to balance customer expectations with operational constraints.

Experience with SaaS, cloud or enterprise software, release management, and Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery methods would be valuable. PRINCE2 Practitioner, AgilePM, PMP, APM PMQ or an equivalent qualification is desirable rather than essential.

This could suit a Software Project Manager, Implementation Project Manager or Digital Project Manager who enjoys client-facing delivery and can align specialists around a shared plan without relying on formal authority.

jobs.title: Digital Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you inspired by connected machines, digital services and turning data into practical customer value? In this role, you will play an important part in developing Tana’s digital services portfolio, including TanaConnect, eSpares and future AI-enabled solutions.

Your responsibilities:

As a Digital Solutions Engineer, you act as the link between business needs, solution users and software development teams. You ensure that digital solutions meet customer needs, support Tana’s long-term vision and deliver measurable value throughout their lifecycle.

You coordinate day-to-day cooperation with our digital development partners, including sprint activities, requirement clarification and development follow-up. You monitor progress and quality, ensure that agreed requirements are met and escalate technical, schedule or resource-related risks when needed.
You gather and analyze requirements from customers, dealers and Tana internal teams and translate them into clear technical specifications. You maintain development backlogs, coordinate acceptance testing and validate delivered functionality against the agreed requirements.

You support the continuous development of TanaConnect and other customer- and dealer-facing digital services. You contribute to the implementation of approved roadmap initiatives and releases and drive continuous improvement across the digital service lifecycle.

You also participate in the development of data-driven services, analytics and AI-enabled solutions. This includes initiatives related to predictive maintenance, intelligent reporting and machine performance monitoring, as well as evaluating new technologies and development opportunities.

What we expect from you:

Are you a software engineer with a passion for technology and a knack for solving complex problems? Join our dynamic team in Singapore as an Engineer, where you'll play a pivotal role in designing, building, testing, deploying, and maintaining our critical trade management system. Our primary development is in Rust, and you'll also work with and support C#/.NET components where appropriate.
We are leveraging Rust to maximize throughput and reliability, minimize memory usage, and ultimately reduce compute and memory costs across our AWS environment (including serverless workloads). You'll work on distributed systems and high-volume processing, collaborating with talented engineers across the globe.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Innovate and Enhance: Design and build Rust-based, multithreaded, high-volume trade flow processing systems.
Interoperate: Integrate with existing C#/.NET services and contribute to those codebases as needed.
Performance & Cost: Profile and optimize latency, memory usage, and resource footprints to reduce AWS costs.
Decision Making: Make independent decisions while effectively mitigating risks.
Ownership Mentality: Take full ownership of all aspects of our trade management systems.

Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in a formal enterprise-level development environment.
Technical Skills:
Strong expertise in Rust/ JAVA/ C# (async/await, concurrency, memory/ownership model, multi-threaded programming) and solid software design skills.

Proven experience in building connected, service-oriented applications (e.g., REST/gRPC, microservices).

Experience with AWS, including serverless technologies (e.g., Lambda) and an understanding of how performance and memory optimizations translate to cost savings.

Full-Stack Development: Working knowledge of modern web and mobile development frameworks, including React.js and Angular.
Financial Markets Knowledge: Understanding of the FIX protocol and Microsoft SQL Server, along with familiarity with U.S. and international equities, fixed income, and commodity markets.

WHY JOIN US

Meaningful Impact: Play a key role in building and enhancing critical systems that support our trading operations.

Collaborative Culture: Join a high-performing, supportive team that values innovation, partnership, and continuous improvement.

What’s more, we’re there to work side-by-side with our client teams to enable them for success long after we’ve gone. We’re all about momentum that outlasts us.

Our Singapore office knows the importance of a good work/life balance. We have the freedom to be ourselves when life gets in the way. It’s an exciting time to be one of our foundational members, getting involved in setting up our unique Singapore culture.

Full Stack Software Developer
• Design and develop software for automated Machine Tool Equipment
• Software design / development for
o Web Applications
o Windows Form Applications
o Web API Services
• Software testing and evaluation
• Technical Support with software deployment and maintenance
Diploma / Degree in Engineering / I.T. discipline
Experience with software development using Microsoft Visual Studio
Development environment proficient in Visual C++ / C#.NET / VB.NET programming language
Experience in .Net with good understanding of ASP.NET is an added advantage
Ability to troubleshoot network problem is an added advantage
Good to have knowledge on Industry 4.0 IoT Solutions
Proficient in English with both written and verbal communication
Fresh graduates are welcome to apply
